en.networkIntro: Scan only when you ask. Every discovered LAN neighbor is shown while names and services fill in progressively. Modern connections authenticate in the system file manager; legacy Time Capsule credentials use the isolated compatibility helper below.
en.networkNotScanned: No scan has run yet. Scan to find devices on this LAN.
en.networkNone: No LAN devices were found. You can refresh when the device is online.
en.networkLegacyWarning: This Time Capsule advertises legacy SMB1. The OS file manager cannot negotiate SMB1 safely, and AFP is unavailable on this system. Configure for backups uses the compatibility workflow; it does not pretend a working connection exists.
en.networkMountsChecked: Mounted folders checked. Only verified mounts count as connected.
en.networkOpenedNotConnected: System authentication opened. This device is not connected until a mount is verified.
en.networkConfigureStarted: Compatibility setup opened. Verify the mount before using it.
en.networkLegacyUnsupported: This legacy SMB1 Time Capsule cannot be opened safely by the system file manager. AFP is unavailable. Compatibility setup is required; no connection has been claimed.
en.networkAfpUnavailable: AFP is advertised by this device, but the current system has no AFP connector. No connection was opened.
en.networkInvalidResponse: The network helper returned an invalid response.
en.networkFailedStart: Could not start the network devices helper.
en.networkTimeCapsuleAuthHint: Enter the account name configured on the Time Capsule. The password is sent only over this helper process's standard input and is cleared after every action.
en.networkPasswordAgain: Enter the password again for this action
en.networkUseSavedCredential: Use saved credential from the system keyring
en.networkChooseShare: Authentication succeeded. Choose an available disk share.
en.networkNoShares: Authentication succeeded, but no disk shares were reported.
en.networkAuthenticatedAvailableHint: The selected share was authenticated and is available to the compatibility helper. It is not mounted in the file manager.
en.networkTimeCapsuleReady: Legacy SMB support is available. Enter your Time Capsule account to continue.
en.networkTimeCapsuleUnavailable: Legacy SMB support is unavailable because smbclient is missing or the helper could not start.
en.networkTimeCapsuleFailedStart: Could not start the Time Capsule compatibility helper.
en.networkAuthenticationFailed: Authentication or share access failed. Check the account and password, then retry.
en.networkKeyringExplanation: Saving is optional. The credential is stored by your desktop's encrypted system keyring for this Time Capsule, account and SMB1 protocol; it is not stored in Control Panel settings.
en.networkCredentialSaved: Credential saved in the system keyring.
en.networkCredentialSaveFailed: The credential could not be saved. Enter the password again and check that the system keyring is unlocked.
en.networkCredentialForgetFailed: No matching saved credential was found, or the system keyring is unavailable.
en.backupIntro: Manual snapshots of configurations and personal files. Nothing runs until you request it. Review selected data: filename exclusions are not secret detection.
en.backupSftpHint: Enter an existing authenticated SFTP rclone remote and a dedicated subdirectory. Configure host-key verification outside this app. Remote history is staged locally and needs free disk space. No credentials are accepted here.
en.backupMountedHint: Use an existing absolute directory outside your home. Mount SMB or Time Capsule first; this app does not mount disks or verify mount identity.
en.backupConfigurations: Configurations · Omarchy, apps, themes and safe Hermes skills/templates
en.backupPathsHint: Optional home-relative paths, one per line. Blank means the entire home with exclusions. No absolute paths or ..; symlinks are skipped.
en.backupRecipient: age1… public recipient key (not a private key)
en.backupEncryptionHint: Keep the private identity offline and separate. Encrypted backups are full snapshots, not incremental. Temporary plaintext uses local disk; use encrypted storage. The manifest still exposes the date and selection flags.
en.backupPlanHint: Read the helper results below, including exclusions, required/missing tools and warnings. The plan does not enumerate your home. Changing any backup option invalidates approval.
en.backupConfirm: I reviewed the plan and selected data; create this snapshot.
en.backupRestoreHint: Restore only into an existing empty staging directory outside your home. The helper rejects live-home overwrite. Review recovered home/ and packages.json before copying files or reinstalling packages manually.
en.backupNoSnapshots: No snapshots found at this destination.
en.backupIdentity: Absolute path to age identity file (never paste its contents)
en.backupRestoreConfirm: I confirm the staging directory is empty and outside my home.
en.backupRunning: Running — please keep this window open
en.backupFailedStart: Could not start the backup helper. Check Python and the helper installation.
en.backupAbsoluteDestination: Use an absolute destination path without .. .
en.backupRemoteDestination: Use a configured SFTP remote:subdirectory, not a remote root or URL.
en.backupRelativePaths: File paths must be home-relative and cannot contain .. .
en.backupChooseRecipient: Enter a native age public key: age1 followed by 58 lowercase letters/digits.
en.backupChooseRestore: Choose a snapshot and an absolute empty staging directory.
en.backupChooseIdentity: Enter the absolute path to your age identity file.

en.pointerFeelDescriptionFine: Short, measured movement for detailed work and small targets.
en.pointerFeelDescriptionBalanced: Controlled at low speed, with enough reach for everyday navigation.
en.pointerFeelDescriptionSwift: More travel from short gestures while retaining adaptive control.
en.pointerFeelDescriptionLinear: The same response at every speed, without pointer acceleration.
en.pointerFeelDescriptionCustom: A manual combination of pointer response, scrolling and acceleration.
en.pointerFeelPracticeHint: Hit the bright node. The route alternates short corrections and long diagonal reaches.
en.noDisplays: Connecting to Hyprland… if this message stays, restart the control panel (omarchy restart shell).
en.displayAtLeastOne: At least one display must stay enabled.
en.displayNoOverlap: Displays cannot overlap. Drag them apart before applying.
en.workspaceMonitorColorHint: Workspaces assigned to this display use this color in the bar.
en.missionControlHint: 3-finger swipe up or SUPER+SHIFT+↑ shows all workspaces with live content. Click one to select it. It follows the Workspace switch transition setting.
en.displayConfirmPrompt: Keep these display settings? Reverting in
en.displayRevertHint: If you don't choose, the previous layout will be restored automatically.
en.multiMonitorWorkspaces: Per display with two or more
en.backupTimeCapsuleCredentialRequired: Verify a share and save its credential in Network Devices first.
en.backupTimeCapsuleEncryptionRequired: Time Capsule SMB1 backups are always encrypted with age.
en.backupTimeCapsuleDirectHelp: This Time Capsule uses isolated SMB1 compatibility access. Select and verify its disk, then explicitly save the credential in Network Devices; no filesystem mount is required.
en.backupIntent: What would you like to do?
en.backupManualOnly: You stay in control. No backups, discovery or connections start automatically.
en.backupDiskHelp: Choose an existing folder on a backup disk, outside your home.
en.backupNativeHelp: Open the connection in your file manager. Sign in there and open the shared folder; this panel never asks for passwords. Return here, check the connection, then choose the backup folder. Opening the file manager does not mean the drive is connected.
en.backupNoMounts: No mounted folders found. Complete sign-in and open the share in your file manager, then check again. You can also select an existing mount with Choose folder.
en.backupMountsFound: Choose a mounted folder below, or browse to a subfolder.
en.backupNoDevices: No Time Capsule found. Enter its host name or IP address manually.
en.backupOpenedNotConnected: File manager opened. Sign in and open the shared folder there, then click Check connection. Not connected yet.
en.backupInstallHint: Missing tools — install with your system package manager, then retry:
en.backupFilesDefault: Personal files includes your whole home with safety exclusions. Limit folders in Advanced if needed.
en.backupEncryptionSimple: Create a recovery key to encrypt this backup. Keep the key safely: you will need it to restore your files.
en.backupKeepKey: Keep this recovery key outside the backup, on separate safe storage. Without it, encrypted recovery is impossible.
en.backupAdvanced: Advanced · folder limits / existing public key
en.backupReviewCaution: Only the selected data will be backed up. Exclusions are not secret detection. Review the warnings; changing an option requires a new review.
en.backupRecovered: Files recovered to staging. Review them before copying anything into your home.
en.backupKeyOutside: Save the recovery key outside the backup folder, with a .key extension.
en.backupConnectionMissing: Connection support is missing. Check connection tools below. On Arch, install glib2, gvfs, gvfs-smb and avahi as needed, then retry.
en.backupChooseFolderError: Choose an existing real folder, not a symbolic link.
en.backupHostError: Enter a valid host name or IP address, without a URL prefix.
en.backupConnectionFailed: Could not complete the connection. Check the address and optional settings, sign in using your file manager, then retry. Technical details are available below.
en.backupNoLocalDevices: No external storage is connected. Connect a USB drive or choose a mounted folder.
en.backupMountFailed: The device could not be mounted. Unlock it in the file manager if it is encrypted, then retry.
en.scrollFeelDevHint: You can try the DEV version, which has a native implementation of Mac touchpad inertia.
en.scrollFeelSupported: Patch detected — values are live. Applies to the touchpad in every app.
en.scrollFeelUnsupported: Requires a Hyprland build with touchpad scroll acceleration (PR #16254). Controls are inactive and nothing is written to the config.
en.scrollFeelDescriptionNative: Compositor default. No acceleration, no coasting.
en.scrollFeelDescriptionLinear: Scroll speed scales proportionally with flick speed.
en.scrollFeelDescriptionAdaptive: Exponential acceleration curve with natural coasting (600 ms).
en.scrollFeelDescriptionGlide: Stronger curve and a long 1 s coast for long documents.
en.scrollFeelDescriptionCustom: Custom combination of curve, boost and coast.
en.scrollIgnoreHint: Except browsers and terminals: uses the browsers' and terminals' own inertia; the patch applies everywhere else. Native turns the patch off completely.
en.scrollIgnoreUnsupported: This build has acceleration and coasting but not scroll_ignore_classes yet — update the patch build to scope where the patch applies.
en.macConfigHint: One click: tap to click, natural scrolling, two-finger right click, pause while typing, 3-finger swipe between workspaces, no middle-button screenshot, inertial scrolling except in browsers and terminals, system animations and workspace transitions.
en.scrollTestHint: Moves with your real input, after the settings above: direction, travel and coasting.
en.profilesSubtitle: Save the current setup under a name and return to it any time.
en.profilesSaveHint: Settings apply instantly on every page. Saving them to the active profile is a separate step.
en.singleWindowSquareHint: A lone tiled window stays centered at 1:1 instead of filling wide screens
en.taskManagerSubtitle: Pauses memory-hungry apps before the desktop freezes · separate plugin
en.taskManagerOffHint: Turn it on to get the bar icon and the memory watchdog
en.taskManagerPaused: %1 paused · open the Task Manager to resume
en.taskManagerWatchdogOff: Watchdog stopped · apps are only paused by hand
en.taskManagerEnableHint: Bar icon, app pausing and the memory watchdog. Off thaws every paused app first
en.tmMaxRam: Pause apps when used RAM reaches

es.networkIntro: La búsqueda se inicia solo cuando tú la pides. Se muestra cada vecino de la red local mientras aparecen progresivamente nombres y servicios. Las conexiones modernas se autentican en el administrador de archivos; las credenciales de Time Capsule antiguas usan el asistente aislado de abajo.
es.networkNotScanned: Aún no se ha buscado. Inicia una búsqueda para encontrar dispositivos en esta red local.
es.networkNone: No se encontraron dispositivos de red. Puedes actualizar cuando el dispositivo esté encendido.
es.networkLegacyWarning: Esta Time Capsule anuncia SMB1 antiguo. El administrador de archivos del sistema no puede negociar SMB1 de forma segura y AFP no está disponible en este sistema. Configurar para respaldos usa el flujo de compatibilidad; no finge que exista una conexión funcional.
es.networkMountsChecked: Montajes comprobados. Solo los montajes verificados cuentan como conectados.
es.networkOpenedNotConnected: Se abrió la autenticación del sistema. El dispositivo no está conectado hasta verificar un montaje.
es.networkConfigureStarted: Se abrió la configuración de compatibilidad. Verifica el montaje antes de usarlo.
es.networkLegacyUnsupported: Esta Time Capsule con SMB1 antiguo no se puede abrir de forma segura en el administrador de archivos. AFP no está disponible. Se requiere configuración de compatibilidad; no se afirma que exista una conexión.
es.networkAfpUnavailable: Este dispositivo anuncia AFP, pero el sistema actual no tiene un conector AFP. No se abrió ninguna conexión.
es.networkInvalidResponse: El asistente de red devolvió una respuesta inválida.
es.networkFailedStart: No se pudo iniciar el asistente de dispositivos de red.
es.networkTimeCapsuleAuthHint: Ingresa el nombre de la cuenta configurada en la Time Capsule. La contraseña solo se envía por la entrada estándar de este proceso auxiliar y se borra después de cada acción.
es.networkPasswordAgain: Ingresa nuevamente la contraseña para esta acción
es.networkUseSavedCredential: Usar credencial guardada en el llavero del sistema
es.networkChooseShare: La autenticación fue correcta. Elige un disco compartido disponible.
es.networkNoShares: La autenticación fue correcta, pero no se informaron discos compartidos.
es.networkAuthenticatedAvailableHint: El disco seleccionado fue autenticado y está disponible para el asistente de compatibilidad. No está montado en el administrador de archivos.
es.networkTimeCapsuleWorking: Comprobando la Time Capsule de forma segura…
es.networkTimeCapsuleReady: El soporte SMB antiguo está disponible. Ingresa tu cuenta de Time Capsule para continuar.
es.networkTimeCapsuleUnavailable: El soporte SMB antiguo no está disponible porque falta smbclient o no se pudo iniciar el asistente.
es.networkTimeCapsuleFailedStart: No se pudo iniciar el asistente de compatibilidad para Time Capsule.
es.networkAuthenticationFailed: Falló la autenticación o el acceso al disco. Revisa la cuenta y la contraseña e inténtalo de nuevo.
es.networkKeyringExplanation: Guardar es opcional. La credencial se almacena en el llavero cifrado del escritorio para esta Time Capsule, cuenta y protocolo SMB1; no se guarda en la configuración del Panel de control.
es.networkSaveCredential: Guardar credencial en el llavero del sistema
es.networkCredentialSaved: Credencial guardada en el llavero del sistema.
es.networkCredentialSaveFailed: No se pudo guardar la credencial. Ingresa nuevamente la contraseña y comprueba que el llavero esté desbloqueado.
es.networkCredentialForgetFailed: No se encontró una credencial coincidente o el llavero del sistema no está disponible.
es.backupIntro: Copias manuales de configuraciones y archivos personales. Nada se ejecuta sin solicitarlo. Revisa los datos: excluir nombres de archivo no detecta todos los secretos.
es.backupSftpHint: Ingresa un remoto SFTP de rclone ya autenticado y una subcarpeta exclusiva. Configura la verificación de la clave del servidor fuera de esta app. El historial remoto se descarga temporalmente y necesita espacio local. Aquí no se aceptan credenciales.
es.backupMountedHint: Usa una carpeta absoluta existente fuera de tu directorio personal. Monta SMB o Time Capsule primero; esta app no monta discos ni verifica la identidad del montaje.
es.backupConfigurations: Configuraciones · Omarchy, apps, temas y skills/plantillas seguras de Hermes
es.backupFiles: Archivos personales · independientes de las configuraciones
es.backupPathsHint: Rutas relativas al directorio personal opcionales, una por línea. Vacío incluye todo el directorio con exclusiones. Sin rutas absolutas ni ..; se omiten enlaces simbólicos.
es.backupRecipient: Clave pública age1… (no una clave privada)
es.backupEncryptionHint: Guarda la identidad privada desconectada y por separado. Los respaldos cifrados son completos, no incrementales. Se usa texto plano temporal en disco local: usa almacenamiento cifrado. El manifiesto expone la fecha y las opciones seleccionadas.
es.backupPlanHint: Lee los resultados del asistente abajo: exclusiones, herramientas necesarias/faltantes y advertencias. El plan no enumera tu directorio personal. Cambiar cualquier opción invalida la aprobación.
es.backupConfirm: Revisé el plan y los datos seleccionados; crear esta copia.
